successors.name: Tsardom of Russia
successors.text: the Lower Don and the Don-Volga steppe, the Host's land

ledger.x: 1549: the first records of the Don Cossack stanitsas.
1642: the Don Host leaves the map as a state (Cliopatria's row ends 1641).

wars.name: Russo-Kazan Wars
wars.outcome: Kazan fell on 2 October 1552; 'In the year 1552 Don Cossacks under the command of Ataman Susar Fedorov joined the Army of Ivan the Terrible'.

wars.name: Russian conquest of Astrakhan
wars.outcome: 'On 2 June 1556 the Cossack regiment of Ataman Lyapun Filimonov ... conquered and annexed the Astrakhan Khanate' for Moscow; the Host gained no land.

wars.name: Siege of Azov (1637-1642)
wars.outcome: Don and Zaporozhian Cossacks took Azov in June 1637 and held it 'for the next five years'; the Ottoman-Tatar army besieged it from 7 June 1641 without success; Moscow, having disowned the Cossacks, ordered the evacuation in March 1642 and the Ottomans…

certainty.note: A steppe and river frontier with no survey or treaty line; the Host's extent is Cliopatria's and no page opened describes it.
